FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 79
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Danny Crawford
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 12/22/2025
House Bill 79 as introduced would combine the existing vessel registration fees that are based
on length and the existing additional $5 registration fee into a single fee. However, this bill
would not affect the distributions to the State Reservoir Management Grant Fund or the State
Water Safety Fund.
